docs.article.harnessDefinition: Domain-Specific AI Harness Platform means a platform that wraps AI models with the context, memory, tools, planning, permissions, review, and workflow needed to complete real work in a specific domain. SmartAIHub provides a place to rent specialized Skills, Agents, and Plugins, so people can start from the outcome they want instead of learning every AI tool first. A model is an engine; a Harness is the complete vehicle that helps the engine reach a destination.
docs.article.content:
SmartAIHub is not built to make people study AI. It is built to help people use AI as a working tool right away.

Many people have ideas, products, stories, and campaigns, but turning those ideas into consistent content takes time and many separate tools. SmartAIHub brings that work into one workspace so one idea can grow into many useful outputs without losing the original context.

Start with the outcome you want. It might be a vertical drama series, a product-review video, a presentation, a media asset, a research-backed story, or another piece of content for the channels you work with. You do not have to begin by learning technical terms or by choosing a different AI application for every step.

Chat is the natural starting point. Describe the work in ordinary language and SmartAIHub can bring the relevant capabilities into the conversation. Behind Chat is a layer of more than 100 specialized Skills for writing, research, images, video, presentations, product reviews, and supporting production tasks. They work like a growing set of assistants: each one is focused, while the workspace keeps the result connected to the next step.

For vertical series, the journey can move from a story idea to the story world, characters, visual identity, storyboard, shot planning, start frames, motion prompts, episode review, and production history. This makes it easier to build a series that feels consistent from one episode to the next, especially when the story is designed for a vertical, mobile-first format.

For product-review videos, the work can begin with real product context. The SmartAIHub Chrome Extension supports capture from Shopee and TikTok Shop. It can detect product candidates or product-page information, while you remain in control of review, editing, evidence selection, and confirmation. Approved product information can then sync into SmartAIHub, where Product Data and Media Studio help shape a review brief, angle, script, scenes, references, and short-form vertical video.

The workspace also includes the surfaces that keep production usable: AI Chat, Media Studio, Storyboard, Vertical Series, Video Studio, Product Data, Presentation, Skills, Media History, Render Queue, Library, Private Files, Finance, Finance Reports, and Credits. These are not separate promises; they are the places where ideas, assets, review, history, and account operations stay connected.

When a team needs more than browser-based creation, the Worker App and local Remotion runtime can support render jobs on a connected machine, with queue and progress visibility. This is a production extension of SmartAIHub, not a replacement for the core creative flow.

For advanced users and teams, SmartAIHub also provides a permissioned MCP connection for compatible clients such as Claude, Codex, Hermes, and other MCP clients. MCP discovery, login, OAuth, scopes, and tenant permissions matter. Not every tool is available to every account, and the Worker App local-render credential is separate from an MCP credential.

The idea is simple: you bring the intent, the product, the story, or the brief. SmartAIHub helps turn it into a connected production path. You can start in Thai or English, begin with Chat, use the Skills that fit the job, build vertical stories or product reviews, organize the media, and connect advanced runtimes only when you need them.

SmartAIHub is for people who want to make useful work with AI now—ordinary users, creators, shop owners, affiliates, agencies, influencers, businesses, and advanced teams building a more connected production system.
docs.article.contentExpanded:
SmartAIHub — AI should become a working tool, not another subject people must master first

1. Why SmartAIHub exists

AI can now write articles, create images, generate videos and audio, build presentations, research information, write code, and coordinate multi-step work. But as AI becomes more capable, people are often asked to learn more tools: which model to use, how to write the right prompt, where to find tools and Skills, how to connect a workflow, and how to move files between systems. One piece of work can require several AI products before it is finished.

SmartAIHub was created to make that path easier. The goal is not to make people study AI until they become experts. The goal is to help ordinary people use AI to do professional-level work more easily.

The idea is simple: you should be able to start with a question such as What do I want to make today? and let the workspace help surface the capabilities and workflow that fit the job. You bring the intent; SmartAIHub helps turn it into a connected path to an output.

2. From one idea to many useful outputs

A single idea can grow through a complete production path:

Idea → Concept / Script → Image / Reference → Storyboard → Video → Social Content → Marketing → Product Review / Affiliate → Automation and AI Agents

Instead of learning every tool separately, SmartAIHub brings AI models, Skills, workflow steps, media creation, files, knowledge, and advanced agent connections into one workspace. This makes it easier to create consistently and reuse the context that has already been established.

3. What SmartAIHub is becoming

SmartAIHub is more than a website that collects many AI tools. It is developing toward an AI Work Hub: a shared working space where AI Models, AI Skills, Workflow, Media Creation, Knowledge and Files, AI Agents, and Team Workspace can work together.

The important part is not the number of menus. It is the connection between them. A user can start with an idea, a question, a product, a source file, or a story, then keep moving through the next useful step without rebuilding the context every time.

4. Who it is for

SmartAIHub is designed to be useful for individual creators, ordinary users, shop owners, affiliate creators, content teams, production teams, marketing agencies, e-commerce teams, influencers, businesses, and organizations. People can start simply with Chat and add more advanced workflow or integration capabilities as their work grows.

It supports Thai and English, keeps the starting point approachable, and is designed to make AI more accessible in terms of workflow complexity and cost. A growing Community and Skills ecosystem can help people share practical ways to get more from the workspace.

5. What is in SmartAIHub today

The current product story includes 15 primary workspace surfaces and more than 100 AI Skills. The capabilities can be understood in four groups.

CREATE — make the work

• AI Chat — start with natural language and let the Skills behind the conversation help move the work forward.
• Media Studio — create and manage image, video, and audio work.
• Storyboard — plan scenes, shots, camera direction, composition, and references before production.
• Vertical Series — build multi-episode vertical stories from story, characters, Story Bible, episodes, storyboard, shots, start frames, and continuity work.
• Video Studio — manage prompts, scenes, video-generation jobs, and the results of each job.
• Product Information — keep product facts, images, and references ready for the next content step.
• Presentation — turn ideas, information, and research into a presentation or deck.

ORGANIZE — keep the work usable

• 100+ AI Skills — focused capabilities for writing, research, images, video, presentations, product reviews, and repeatable workflow steps.
• Media History — return to work that has already been created and continue from its context.
• Render Queue — follow the status of generation and render work.
• Library — keep useful outputs and references ready to reuse.
• Private Files — manage source files and private material used by workflows.

CONTROL — understand and manage usage

• Finance — manage usage and account information.
• Finance Reports — inspect usage details and reports.
• Credits — understand and manage the credits or capacity used by AI operations.

ORGANIZATION & SECURITY — work with teams and organizations

SmartAIHub supports a multi-tenant direction in which an organization can have its own tenant and workspace. The system is designed around Tenant Isolation, Data Isolation, Access Control, Organization Workspace, and Private Organization Data.

Project data, media, library items, Private Files, Product Data, render jobs, and usage history can be governed within the tenant boundary of the organization. The guiding principle is that people should see only the information their identity and organization are allowed to access.

This organization layer is not a separate creative tool. It is the safety and collaboration boundary that allows the same workspace concept to serve an individual creator, a content team, a production team, an agency, an e-commerce operation, or a larger company.

6. Workflows that connect the capabilities

For a vertical series, the connected path can look like this:

Idea → Story → Character → Story Bible → Episode → Storyboard → Shot → Start Frame → Video → Continuity Check → Series

The goal is to keep the story world, visual identity, episode context, and production history connected so a multi-episode vertical series can move forward with more consistency.

For product and commerce content, the path can look like this:

Product Information → AI Skill → Research → Script → Storyboard → Image → Video Review → Library → Social Content

The workflow can begin from product facts and references, then move through research, a review angle, script, scenes, visuals, video, and reusable content.

7. Chrome Extension for product content

The SmartAIHub Chrome Extension supports product capture from Shopee and TikTok Shop. It can help detect product candidates or product-page details and bring selected information, images, and evidence into the workspace.

The user remains in control: review the captured data, edit it, select the evidence to keep, and confirm before upload or sync. The approved product context can then support Product Information, research, review scripts, storyboard planning, Media Studio work, and vertical product-review videos.

This is especially useful for shop owners, affiliates, e-commerce teams, and creators who want to turn real product information into content without copying the same details across many tools.

8. Worker App and local rendering

When browser-based creation is not enough for a production job, the Worker App and local Remotion runtime can connect a client machine to supported render work. Teams can use the connected runtime to receive jobs and follow queue or progress state while the main creative context remains in SmartAIHub.

The local render runtime is a production extension of the workspace. It is separate from the MCP credential and should not be described as the MCP server itself.

9. MCP, external clients, and AI Agents

SmartAIHub can expose capabilities through Model Context Protocol for compatible external clients and agents such as Hermes, Claude or Claude Code, Codex, and other MCP clients. The connection is permissioned: discovery, login, OAuth, scopes, and tenant policy still determine what a user or client can access.

The longer-term direction is to reduce the number of manual steps a user needs to perform. Instead of opening every tool, a user could ask an agent to create an illustration, send a storyboard to video production, or check the status of a render job. An agent can then call SmartAIHub tools through MCP and continue a workflow, where the account and permissions allow it.

The direction can be summarized as:

AI Tools → AI Skills → AI Workflow → AI Agents

When organization support is included, the larger picture becomes:

AI Workspace + Skills + Workflow + Agents + Multi-Tenant Platform

These are connected-product directions, not a promise that every agent action is available to every account today.

10. The principle behind SmartAIHub

The long-term goal is not to make users memorize which AI model is behind each step. It is to let them say what work they need to do and have AI help guide that work toward a useful result, with the right context, files, Skills, workflow, and permissions connected along the way.

SmartAIHub is turning AI from something people feel they must study into an assistant that helps work get finished.

SmartAIHub — you do not have to be good at AI before you can start creating with AI.

contact.faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
contact.faq.response.question: How quickly will I receive a response?
contact.faq.response.answer: We typically respond within 24 hours during business days. Sales & Enterprise messages are marked urgent for Admin review.
contact.faq.line.question: How can I contact support?
contact.faq.line.answer: Please contact us through Line using the QR code above. Your message will be routed to the SmartAIHub Feedback Hub for Admin review.
contact.faq.demo.question: Can I schedule a demo?
contact.faq.demo.answer: Yes! Select Sales & Enterprise and mention that you would like a demo. The message will be sent to our Admin team as urgent.
contact.faq.docs.question: Where can I find documentation?
contact.faq.docs.answer: Visit our Docs page for guides and product information.
